en.summary: Animal markets in Amasya were temporarily closed following cases of lumpy skin disease in the region. Provincial authorities took action in response to the outbreak.

en.summary: The AKP plans to submit a ten-article bill to parliament concerning the liquidation and repayment of funds. The measure addresses fund-related financial matters.

en.summary: The AKP plans to submit a bill to parliament this week establishing a payment schedule for fund crisis victims, with initial payments to those with investments under 1 million Turkish lira, followed by larger investors.

en.title: Shocking incident in Isparta: Coffin falls from hearse onto road
en.summary: A coffin fell onto the road after the rear door of a moving hearse opened in Isparta. The driver and other motorists stopped their vehicles and the coffin was returned to the hearse.

en.title: New era in foreign accommodation platforms: permission requirement coming for operations in Turkey
en.summary: Turkey is introducing new regulations for foreign digital accommodation platforms operating in the country, requiring them to obtain permission from the Ministry. The permission fee will be 5 million lira, and commission rates on domestic sales cannot exceed 17 percent.
